description: The line plot illustrates the evaluation perplexity for different model configurations across varying activated parameters ratios. The x-axis is labeled "Activated Parameters Ratio(%)" and features a reversed linear scale decreasing from left to right, with a range from 100 to 25 and tick labels at intervals of 25. The y-axis is labeled "Eval PPL." and utilizes a linear scale with tick marks ranging from 11.5 to 14.0 at intervals of 0.5, accompanied by horizontal dashed grid lines. The plot contains four lines identified in a top-left legend. The "Transformer" line is a dark red dashed line without markers that maintains a steady horizontal trend at a value of approximately 11.6 across the entire x-axis from 100 to 25. The "Only MoHD FFN" line is a solid gray line with square markers; it begins at approximately 11.45 at an x-value of 100, decreases slightly to roughly 11.3 at 50, and then rises to end at approximately 11.8 at an x-value of 25. The "Only MoHD ATTN" line is a solid dark blue line with circle markers, starting at approximately 11.45 at an x-value of 100, rising to about 11.6 at 75, continuing upward to roughly 12.25 at 50, and reaching a peak of approximately 14.3 at an x-value of 25. Finally, the "MoHD ATTN + MLP" line is a solid blue line with cross markers that starts at approximately 11.45 at an x-value of 100, increases slightly to 11.5 at 75, rises to about 12.05 at 50, and concludes at approximately 13.2 at an x-value of 25.
caption_used: The line plot illustrates the evaluation perplexity (PPL) across varying ratios of activated parameters measured in percentage. The x-axis is labeled as 'Activated Parameters Ratio (%)' and ranges from 25 to 100 in reverse order, with tick labels at intervals of 25. The y-axis is labeled 'Eval PPL' with a linear scale from 11.5 to 14.0 and tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The red dashed line labeled 'Transformer' remains horizontal across the x-axis at a PPL of approximately 11.6. The gray line with square markers for 'Only MoHD FFN' starts at a PPL of about 11.5 at 100% activation, decreases slightly to a PPL of 11.2 at 50%, then rises again to approximately 11.8 at 25%. The purple line with circle markers for 'Only MoHD ATTN' starts at about 11.5, rises significantly to around 14.0 at 25%. The blue line with cross markers for 'MoHD ATTN + MLP' begins at 11.5 and follows an upward trend to approximately 13.8 at 25%. A legend is placed at the top left corner of the plot, indicating the methods compared.
